sentences.en: I have seldom seen such a beautiful sunset as this.
sentences.zh: 我很少见到如此美丽的日落。

sentences.en: We were able to see the sunset from our window.
sentences.zh: 我们从窗户可以看到日落。

sentences.en: Did you see the sunset earlier? It was really beautiful.
sentences.zh: 你刚才看到日落了吗？真的很美呢。

senses.zh: 日落，傍晚；（事物的）衰落期，没落期
